lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I told you I would find the truth about who framed me for the theft of Evelyn's necklace, Diane.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: You think your pathetic nurse salary gives you leverage against me, Harper?

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I found Evelyn's personal ledger hidden behind the bookshelf, Diane, and it proves you poisoned the 81-year-old matriarch.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: That ledger is a forgery, and my son Jake will make sure you rot in a cell for stealing it.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Stop right there, Diane, before you frame my 24-year-old wife Harper for another crime she didn't commit!

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Look who decided to crawl out of the hospital despite your bleeding post-surgery bandages, Cole.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Cole, your reckless stepmother just planted the stolen necklace inside my nursing bag again while the police were outside!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: I know her game, Harper, because my late grandmother Evelyn left me the exact proof of who killed her.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Shoot him, Jake, finish what we started in the study or we lose the entire Whitmore shipping empire!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Put the gun down, Mother, because the police cars are already turning into the driveway.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Then we frame Harper for stealing the ledger and murdering Evelyn right now before they see us!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Run, Cole, they've locked the front gates and the crooked detective is stepping out of his cruiser!
